parsed.scene_description: A low-angle shot inside a large warehouse with high shelves stocked with boxes and red crates. Workers in red and black uniforms move through aisles. Signs indicate sections like 'FLEISCH 2' and 'FLEISCH 3'. The floor is concrete, and lighting comes from overhead fixtures. Motion blur suggests activity.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: A person in motion, wearing dark pants and a red-and-black jacket, strides across the foreground. Their legs and arms show motion blur. They appear to be walking toward the right side of the frame. No clear contact with any object is visible.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked red plastic crates sit on a gray pallet near the center-right. Some are stacked vertically, others lie horizontally. They are positioned under a metal shelf structure. One crate is partially obscured by another.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Metal shelving units line both sides of the aisle, extending into the background. They hold cardboard boxes and red crates. Yellow safety rails run along the top edges. Signs with German text are mounted on some shelves.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Numerous brown cardboard boxes are stacked on pallets and on shelves. Labels are visible on some boxes. They are arranged in orderly piles, primarily on the left side of the aisle and on upper shelves.

objects.label: sign with text
objects.observation: A red sign with white text reading 'FLEISCH 2' is mounted on a metal shelf. Another similar sign reading 'FLEISCH 3' is visible further back on the left. Both signs are rectangular and affixed to vertical metal structures.

objects.label: worker in background
objects.observation: A second worker in a red shirt and dark pants stands near a red storage unit on the right side of the frame. They appear to be handling items. Their face is not clearly visible due to distance and angle.
